programme.title: Forensic Files: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: Two sets of scientists probe a woman's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kill'igraphy
programme.desc: This examination of the role autopsies play in murder investigations focuses on the suspicious death of Virginia Ridley. Police charge her mentally unstable husband with murder, but a medical examiner discovers that she died of natural causes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ticker Tape
programme.desc: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Knot for Everyone
programme.desc: The bodies of several women are found on a remote hill in California. The police get a break when a prostitute escapes and is able to identify her attacker and his automobile.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ghost in the Machine
programme.desc: While investigating the apparent overdose suicide of Reverend Bill Guthrie's wife, detectives recover incriminating files from Bill's computer and learn of his infidelity.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Touching Recollection
programme.desc: The investigation into the kidnapping and rape of an 18-year-old Ohio woman is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Suspect
programme.desc: The wife of a respected police officer was murdered in her own home. The crime went unsolved for more than a decade, until a newly formed cold case unit took a fresh look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dessert Served Cold
programme.desc: A man dies in his home after a long history of heart disease. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surface that the death was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, 6-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her Minnesota church during an evening service. After receiving a tip that an older man was seen carrying a small person, police found Cassie's body in a dumpster.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grounds for Indictment
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sip of Sins
programme.desc: In the 1980s, a trio of unsolved murders occurred in Wichita Falls, Texas. Later, a fourth murder from the same time period provided the police with far more than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Partners in Crime
programme.desc: In a 1992 murder case, the autopsy of a cremated body turns up telltale clues of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insignificant Others
programme.desc: How unlucky could one man be? His college sweetheart killed herself and fourteen years later, his wife ended her life in a similar way. Investigators had to determine if this was murder or simply a bizarre coincidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Music Case
programme.desc: In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her Minnesota home. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: If I Were You
programme.desc: Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from her father, but written in a stranger's handwriting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nursery Crimes
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the mysterious death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Breaking News
programme.desc: A young TV news producer is raped and murdered in her apartment. Police identify two suspects, but both are cleared of any wrongdoing. When the case stalls for more than a year, investigators turn to the Commonwealth of Virginia's DNA Databank.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up
programme.desc: In 1996, Derrick Duehren returned to find his Oregon home burned to the ground. His wife's charred remains were later found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the "Last Call Killer" because he targeted men in gay bars who were obviously intoxicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft. Lauderdale neighborhood. The prosecutor combines the talents of an accident reconstruction expert with a video specialist to create a graphic demonstration of the moment of impact.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings kill two people and injure one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Internal Affair
programme.desc: When a woman went missing, friends and family were determined to find her. Their worst fears were confirmed weeks later when her body was discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: The doctors at the hospital couldn't determine the cause of Bobby Curley's hallucinations and intense pain. They treated it as a neurological disorder but his condition deteriorated. He was being poisoned.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Scratching The Surface
programme.desc: The only clue recovered from a shooting is a twelve-guage shotgun. Scientists use unique methods to lift the serial number from the weapon to trace it to its owner

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair of the Dog
programme.desc: Investigators are baffled after finding a murder scene devoid of any physical evidence, but they suspect that the victim's dog had witnessed the crime. If so, forensic scientists would have to find some way to learn what the dog had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bitter Potion
programme.desc: Flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children prove to be something more serious: thallium poisoning. After the mother's death, investigators turn their attention to finding the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over and Out
programme.desc: When a pipe bomb rips through a rural home, police have no idea who is responsible. A 9-volt battery and the remnants of a mailing label ead investigators to the man who made the bomb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Printed Proof
programme.desc: When two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered, police wondered if they were victims of a hate crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left her church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. After clearing her husband, police turned their attention to Fred Andros, with whom Susan had an affair.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The G-Bomb

programme.desc: Kavos. Chloe bliver jaloux på Holly og Marty. Marnie er vred over, at Aaron rejste uden at sige noget. Scott får store nyheder, og en chokerende ankomst får enorme konsekvenser for Gaz og Chantelle.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Here's Nathan!
programme.desc: Kavos. Stemningen er anspændt mellem Sophie, Gaz og Chantelle. Aaron kommer endelig tilbage, men Marnie bliver ikke glad. Chantelle og Marty skændes om Chloe og Chantelle tager en vigtig beslutning.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Playing Mind Games
programme.desc: Dagen efter Chantelle er rejst får Sophie en stor nyhed fra chefen Anna, Aaron bliver hentet af en ambulance og Chloe prøver at komme sig over Marty. Men da Marty scorer igen, går det hurtigt helt skævt.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Gaz's True Feelings
programme.desc: Napa. Marty kommer på hospitalet efter strandfesten, Anna har store nyheder til Sophie, og Holly er ked af det. Nathan har en plan for at hjælpe Chloe, mens Gaz har bestemt sig om Charlotte. Aaron bliver vred, da Marnie nærmer sig Marty.

programme.desc: Napa. Der er stor krise. Marty vil slutte fred med Chloe, men kan hun tilgive ham? Kan Aaron og Marnie forsones igen efter skænderiet i går? Til poolfesten vakler Holly efter Kyles bungyjump går galt.

programme.desc: Strandfest i Napa. Chloe og Marty flirter igen, kan de bare være venner? Kyle får store nyheder fra Anna, Holly kan ikke lide det og tager en afgørende beslutning. Sidste afsnit.

programme.desc: Annas plan for at finde de bedste nye deltagere fortsætter. Aaron og Marty vil lære Sarah og Abbie bedre at kende. Efter skænderiet med Zahida får Chloe store nyheder, og familien bliver chokeret, da to nye deltagere kommer.

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Caroline Fleming
programme.desc: Casper Christensen har fælles venner med Caroline Fleming, men har i årenes løb undgået hende. Nu vil han de næste 24 timer finde ud af hvad hun gemmer på indeni.

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Ulrich Thomsen
programme.desc: Ulrich Thomsen er en af Danmarks mest kendte skuespillere men samtidigt en ekstremt privat person. Mikael udfordrer derfor Casper til at finde ud af hvem Ulrich er inden solen går ned.

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Kasper Schmeichel
programme.desc: Efter Casper og Kaspers første møde, endte Casper med at brænde Kasper af. Nu besøger Casper og Mikael familien Schmeichel i Nice for at få revanche og se hvad der gemmer sig bag muren.

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Thomas Blachman
programme.desc: Det er første gang Casper Christensen inviterer en gæst, han aldrig før har talt med, og han er reelt i tvivl om han svinger med Thomas Blachman. Kan han trænge igennem til Thomas som privatperson?

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Morten Messerschmidt
programme.desc: Casper Christensen har mødt Morten Messerschmidt, men kender ham udelukkende som politiker. Er det muligt for Casper at komme bag politikerens velformulerede facade og ind til mennesket?

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Medina
programme.desc: Svigermor og to små børn er med på sidelinjen, da Medina ankommer til slottet i Sverige. Mikael Bertelsen tager imod, men noget helt uforudset sker efter Medina og Casper Christensens ellers gode snak.

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Thomas Helmig
programme.desc: Det er første gang i et årti, at Thomas er med i et program som sig selv. Det er ikke let, for han har nemlig kæmpet med at finde grænsen mellem Thomas Helmig som person og Thomas Helmig-personaen.

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Iben Hjejle
programme.desc: Casper Christensen og Iben Hjejle gik fra hinanden for ti år siden, og det tidligere kærestepar har ikke rigtigt talt om bruddet siden. Nu skal de spendere et helt døgn sammen.

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Helle Thorning-Schmidt
programme.desc: Er det første gang Helle Thorning-Schmidt og Casper Christensen møder hinanden? Ja, mener hun. Nej, fastslår han. I det kommende døgn bliver der talt om samtykke over et slag bordtennis og ’deep like’.

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Lars Hjortshøj
programme.desc: Casper Christensen og Lars Hjortshøj har været tætte venner i årtier. Men de seneste år er venskabet gledet ud i sandet, og nu er Casper nysgerrig på hvor deres venskab er nu og om det kan genoplives.

programme.title: All Exclusive: All Exclusive: Sofie Linde
programme.desc: Casper Christensen glæder sig til at give Sofie Linde gode råd fra et langt liv i underholdningsbranchen. Men sådan går det ikke. De to tørner sammen i diskussioner om alt fra kønsidentitet til SoMe.

programme.title: A Christmas Blessing
programme.desc: Mandy sælger sin afdøde tantes hjælpeorganisation til den tilstødende virksomhedsejer Adam. Men Otto, som har været frivillig på stedet, vil gerne afholde en sidste velgørende julemiddag.

programme.title: A Christmas... Present
programme.desc: Maggie fejrer jul med sin bror Paul og hans datter, efter at hans kone døde for nylig. Det får hende til at indse, hvad der mangler i hendes liv.

programme.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
programme.desc: To rivaliserende ejendomsmæglere er tvunget til at arbejde sammen for at sælge et særligt hus, der ejes af en kendt botaniker og misteltenavler, lige op til jul.

programme.title: A Dash of Christmas
programme.desc: Megan har fundet sit drømmejob i en madvirksomhed, men først må hun lære at bage. Da hun rekrutterer en flot bager til at hjælpe sig, ender hun uforvarende med at deltage i en julebagekonkurrence.

programme.title: Hotel for the Holidays
programme.desc: Mens hoteldirektør Georgia navigerer i romantiske forviklinger med kokken og en flot prins, får vi et glimt af de andre gæsters og personalets liv på Hotel Maison i New York.

programme.title: En ny chance til jul
programme.desc: En kvinde rejser et år tilbage i tiden. Tilbage til julen før hendes forlovelse gik i stykker, hvor hun vil forsøge at reparere, det der gik galt. Hun opdager at det er måske en større opgave end hun troede.

programme.title: A Wish for Christmas
programme.desc: Sara foretrækker at sidde på sidelinjen på arbejdet, men da hendes juleidé bliver stjålet, ønsker hun, at hun endelig får mod til at stå op for sig selv. Kan julemanden opfylde hendes ønske?

programme.title: Christmas Party Crashers
programme.desc: Da to svindlere mødes efter at have crashet den samme millionærs julefrokost, bliver de enige om at samarbejde – uvidende om, at de snart finder noget, der er vigtigere end rigdom og berømmelse: ægte kærlighed.

programme.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
programme.desc: En kommunaldirektør får hjælp af sin barndomsven til at arrangere byens julevelgørenhedsarrangement, og samtidigt forsøger hun at splejse ham sammen med sin nære veninde.

programme.title: Christmas Unfiltered
programme.desc: Beckys juleønske er, at hendes familie for én gangs skyld vil høre på hende. Men så begynder alle hendes tanker og frustrationer at vælte ud, da hun ufrivilligt begynder at fortælle alle, hvad hun virkelig tænker.

programme.title: The Christmas Spirit
programme.desc: Charlotte ender i koma efter en ulykke, men hendes sjæl er vågen. Inden en afstemning om et ejendomsprojekt skal hun få sin by og bygherren til at skifte mening, mens ingen kan se eller høre hende.

programme.title: A Christmas Blessing
programme.desc: Mandy sælger sin afdøde tantes hjælpeorganisation til den tilstødende virksomhedsejer Adam. Men Otto, som har været frivillig på stedet, vil gerne afholde en sidste velgørende julemiddag.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Omfavn intetheden
programme.desc: Korra beslutter sig for at ofre alt.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Den Røde Lotus' gift
programme.desc: Zaheer iværksætter sin dødelige plan.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Efter alle disse år
programme.desc: Der er nu gået tre år siden Zaheer forgiftede Korra, og medlemmerne af Team Avatar er kommet videre i deres tilværelser, Kai og Opal hjælper en hårdtkæmpende landsby i Jordriget.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Korra alene i Verden
programme.desc: Korras tre år lange rejse fører hende helt uventede steder hen.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Kroningen
programme.desc: Prins Wus store dag bliver ødelagt af Kuvira, Korra tror at hun har fundet kuren til at blive helt rask igen.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Kaldet
programme.desc: Tenzin sender Jinora, Ikki og Meelu ud på deres livs vigtigste mission - for at finde Korra.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Fjenden står for døren
programme.desc: Kuvira truer Zaofu, Bolin er fanget midt i opgøret mellem Su Beifong og Kuvira.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Kampen om Zaofu
programme.desc: Korra vender tilbage til rollen som Avatar, men er hun overhoved klar til det endnu? Bolin og Varrick flygter fra Kuviras hær.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Genforening
programme.desc: Korra vender tilbage til Republka og Team Avatar tager ud på deres første mission sammen efter tre år, da Prins Wu pludselig forsvinder. Bolin og Varrick er på flugt.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Erindringer
programme.desc: Et tilbageblik på Team Avatars lange rejse, Varrick fortæller historien om den bedste film der nogensinde er blevet lavet.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Bag Vildnisset
programme.desc: Ånderødderne i Republika er begyndt at kidnappe folk, og det er Korras opgave at finde ud af hvorfor.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Operation: Beifong
programme.desc: Bolin hjælper Opal og Lin med redde Beifong fra Kurviva; Korra søger hjælp fra åndeverdenen

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Kuviras udspil
programme.desc: Korra og Team Avatar forsøger at stoppe Kuvira fra at rykke mod Republic City; Kuvira afslører et dødbringende nyt våben.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Kolossens dag
programme.desc: Team Avatar kolliderer med Kuvira på vej af Republic City; Pema og Prince Wu hjælper med at evakuere uskyldige borgere.

programme.title: Legenden om Korra: Det endelige opgør
programme.desc: Jordrigets skæbne og Avatarens liv står på spil, når Korra kommer fra ansigt til ansigt med Kuvira

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Drengen i isbjerget
programme.desc: Da en ung vandbetvinger, ved navn Katara, og hendes bror, Sokka, under en fisketur ved deres hjem på Sydpolen, ser et kæmpe isbjerg, opdager de at der er en dreng, ved navn Aang, indeni.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Avataren vender tilbage
programme.desc: Efter at Aang, ved et uheld, udløser en af Ildlandets fælder, bliver han forvist fra Sydpolen. Kort efter, angriber Prins Zuko den sydlige Vandstamme, i håb om at fange Avataren. Aang vender tilbage og overgiver sig, for at redde Vandstammen.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Lufttemplet mod syd
programme.desc: Aang er ivrig efter at vise Sokka og Katara Lufttemplet han voksede op i, men da de ankommer, er det tydeligt, at templet ikke er som Aang husker det.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Krigerne fra Kyoshi
programme.desc: På en af Aangs små omveje, ender gruppen på øen Kyoshi. Du opdager hurtigt, at indbyggerne ikke stoler på fremmede; men da Aang beviser overfor dem, at han er Avatar, bliver de behandlet som æresgæster.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Kongen fra Omashu
programme.desc: Aang viser Katara og Sokka et af de steder han plejede at besøge, da han var yngre; byen Omashu i Jordriget. Men da de bryder loven, bliver de ført hen til kongen for at få deres straf.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Fanget
programme.desc: Ungerne ankommer til en Jordlandsby, der er blevet indtaget af Ildlandet. Men vil Kataras forsøg på at inspirere det undertrykte folk hjælpe dem eller skade dem?

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Vintersolhverv del 1 Åndeverdenen
programme.desc: Aang, Katara og Sokka ankommer til en by, der bliver terroriseret af en mystisk kraft fra Åndeverdenen. Aang ved ikke hvordan han skal hjælpe indbyggerne, og indser at han har meget at lære om at være Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Vintersolhverv del 2: Avatar Roku
programme.desc: Under vintersolhvervet, skal Aang nå til et af Ildlandets templer, imens han prøver at undgå Prins Zuko, Zhao og ildvismændene, der bevogter det.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Vandbetvingerrullen
programme.desc: Efter Kataras forsøg på at lære Aang at vandbetvinge, er hun desperate efter at forbedre sine evner.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Jet
programme.desc: På vej mod Nordpolen, bliver gruppen næsten fanget af Ildlandet.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Den dybe kløft
programme.desc: Da Aang og hans venner når til randen af en kæmpe kløft, bliver de bedt om at hjælpe to grupper flygtninge over.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Stormen
programme.desc: En kraftig storm hvirvler smertefulde minder op fra fortiden, og sætter alle i fare i nutiden.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Den blå ånd
programme.desc: Da Sokka og Katara bliver syge på grund af stormen, forsøger Aang at finde en kur, og opdager at han har brug for frosne frøer for at kurere dem.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Spåkonen
programme.desc: Aang, Katara og Sokka finder en by, hvis indbyggere er afhængige af en spåkone i deres hverdag - men de er blevet så afhængige, at de er blevet blinde overfor den immanente fare de alle er i.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Bato af Vandstammen
programme.desc: Aang bliver usikker, da Katara og Sokka finder noget, der minder dem om deres hjem. I frygt for at hans venner vil forlade ham, skjuler Aang en vigtig meddelelse, der volder dem problemer.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Desertøren
programme.desc: Aang prøver at finde en mester i ildbetvingning, der kan undervise ham, imens Katara opdager at hun har en særlig evne.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Det Nordlige Lufttempel
programme.desc: Efter at have hørt rygter om overlevende luftbetvinger, tager gruppen til det Nordlige Lufttempel, for at se det med egne øjne. Det de finder, kan betyder undergangen for alle Ildlandets fjender.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Mesteren i vandbetvingning
programme.desc: Ungerne når til den Nordlige Vandstamme, og imens Aang og Katara leder efter mesteren i vandbetvingning, forelsker Sokka sig i en prinsesse. I mellemtiden planlægger Zhao at angribe, og Zuko må finde en måde at fortsætte sin søgen efter Avataren på.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Belejringen mod Nord del 1
programme.desc: Den Nordlige Vandstamme forbereder sig på et angreb af Admiral Zhaos Ildflåde. I kampens hede, kæmper Aang for at forsvare byen. Han overvejer, om der ikke findes en bedre måde at udnytte sine Avatar evner på.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Belejringen mod Nord del 2
programme.desc: Zhaos invasion nedbryder den yderste mur af den Nordlige Vandstammes forsvar, og han afslører en skummel plan.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Avartar Form
programme.desc: Aang og de andre, møder en general fra Jordlandet, der vil bruge Aangs mægtige 'Avatar Form' som et våben, til at slå Ildlandet. Men at opnå 'Avatar Form' bevidst, er langt sværere end Aang tror.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: De to elskendes hule
programme.desc: På vej til Omashu, møder ungerne en gruppe nomader, der viser dem en genvej igennem 'De to elskendes hule'.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Rejsen tilbage til Omashu
programme.desc: Børnene vender tilbage til Omashu, så Aang kan lære at jordbetvinge af kong Bumi. Men de får et chok, fordi byen er i Ildlandets hænder. Aang og Omashu trodser farer og søger efter kong Bumi.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Sumpen
programme.desc: Ungerne ender i en mystisk og underlig sump, hvor deres frygt bliver blottet. Og Aang lærer at 'blive forbundet med Jorden', af en han ikke havde regnet med.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Avatar Dag
programme.desc: Aang skal rydde op i en bølge af anti-Avatar følelser, og rode bod på noget han gjorde i fortiden.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Den blinde bandit
programme.desc: I søgen efter en jordbetvingningslærer til Aang, tager ungerne til en underjordisk jordbetvingnings turnering, hvor de møder Toph, en blind, men mægtig jordbetvinger.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Zuko er alene
programme.desc: Nu hvor Zuko ikke længere følges med Onkel Iroh, ankommer han til en by styret af Jordlandet, hvor han knytter bånd til en lokal dreng. Men Zuko bliver hjemsøgt af minderne fra hans barndom.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Jagten
programme.desc: Ungerne bliver ubønhørtligt forfulgt af en mystisk maskine, og deres udmattelse får dem til at fare i totterne på hinanden.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Hårdt arbejde
programme.desc: Da Aang kæmper med en blokade, da Toph prøver at lære ham at jordbetvinge, overvejer han om problemet er ham selv eller hans lærer. I mellemtiden får Sokka sig selv i knibe.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Biblioteket
programme.desc: En professor fører ungerne hen til et åndebibliotek midt ude i ørkenen, hvor Sokka håber at finde mægtige hemmeligheder, til brug i kampen mod Ildlandet.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Ørkenen
programme.desc: Aang leder efter Appa, og samtidig kæmper Katara for at holde alle samlet, så de kan overleve i den golde ørken. I mellemtiden, får Onkel og Zuko hjælp fra et hemmeligt gammelt samfund.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende
programme.desc: Gruppen samles om kortet, for at diskutere hvilke retning de skal gå i - Slangens Pas virker som den mest lige rute.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Øvelsen
programme.desc: Aang opdaget et af Ildlandets hemmelige supervåben, der har retning mod Ba Sing Se, og forsøger at stoppe det, inden det ødelægger den store mur, der beskytter byen mod angreb.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Byen af mure og hemmeligheder
programme.desc: Aang og ungerne ankommer endelig i Ba Sing Se, for at tale med Jordkongen, men opdager at mystiske kræfter i byen, prøver at stoppe dem. I mellemtiden prøver Jet at finde beviser på, at Zuko og Onkel kommer fra Ildlandet.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Fortællingen om Ba Sing Se
programme.desc: En række korte fortællinger, fremhæves forskellige karakterer og deres individuelle oplevelser i byen. Historier om Katara og Toph, Aang, Zuko og Momo.

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Appas fortabte dage
programme.desc: I dette særlige afsnit, går vi tilbage til det øjeblik, hvor Appa blev bortført, for at finde ud af hvad der præcis skete med ham, og hvor han har opholdt sig i al den tid - og hvor han er nu!

programme.title: Avatar- Aangs Legende: Laogai søen
programme.desc: I dette særlige afsnit, går vi tilbage til det øjeblik, hvor Appa blev bortført, for at finde ud af hvad der præcis skete med ham, og hvor han har opholdt sig i al den tid - og hvor han er nu!

programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s the drug trade ravaged Chicago's inner city neighborhoods. Heroin and cocaine sales soared. Violent crime threatened to destroy the community.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: They were a gang of criminal masterminds. They carried automatic weapons and were not afraid to use them. With each and every new heist, they became bolder and more deadly, until the FBI stepped in, determined to end their violent rampage.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Surveillance video is often the most precise witness to a crime. After three brutal murders were caught on tape in Alabama, the suspects fled the area. They had an arsenal of stolen weapons, and swore they wouldn't be taken alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1980s the FBI matched wits with a cunning bank robber, a lone gunman responsible for the longest string of unsolved bank robberies in FBI history.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Predator
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Puerto Rico, a band of extremists waged a guerrilla war against the United States. Their goal, to make the island an independent nation, or die trying.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Too often, convicted felons learn new techniques and find new partners in prison. In 1982, a group of former inmates began a spree of kidnapping and robbery.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Betrayed
programme.desc: On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her ten-year-old son was missing from his school. When a child of separated parents disappears, investigators first look at the family and divorced parents often suspect each other.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Women are most often assaulted by someone they know. Near Las Vegas in December of 2000 a young woman became the latest victim of a violent sex offender. Before authorities could locate him, he would add murder to his list of crimes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: A serial rapist targeted women. His dark urges raged out of control and led him to murder. He followed a path so random it was impossible to trace, and all that tied him to his crimes were his access to the highways and a bizarre sexual fetish.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dare To Dream
programme.desc: Denne sæson har 400 piger turde drømme stort. De vil blive en af de verdensberømte Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders. De satser alt, når de indledende udtagelser til truppen 2015-2016 begynder.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dance Your Heart Out
programme.desc: 23 veteraner melder sig til udtagelserne for at konkurrere mod 59 nybegyndere, som vil tage deres pladser. Talent og udseende er ikke nok til en plads i truppen. Drømme går både i opfyldelse og bliver knust, da 46 kommer med på lejren.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: An Emotional Beginning
programme.desc: Træningslejren begynder, og Kelli viser, hvor skabet skal stå. Nogle piger bryder sammen, da de indser, hvor svært det er at blive en DCC. Melissa Rycroft giver dem håb og råd om, hvordan de skal klare sig.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Cuts Begin
programme.desc: Kelli og Judy må sende ti piger hjem for at komme ned til truppens magiske 36. Uniformprøven viser Kelli, hvem der har det hele. Når de begynder at sende folk hjem, bliver drømme knust.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Becoming World Class
programme.desc: Pigerne får DCC-looket, hvilket hjælper nogle, men ikke andre. To gæster overrasker til træningen og rocker DCC's verden. Kelli oplever et af de mest pinlige kontorbesøg nogensinde.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Having A Bad Day
programme.desc: Fotografering og showgruppe-udtagelser presser de nye og veteranerne til grænsen. Melissa Rycroft prøver at redde en DCC, som hænger i en tynd tråd, og et besøg på Kellis kontor ender på en chokerende måde.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Cutting Board
programme.desc: Nerverne er på højkant, da Kelli og Judy må træffe svære valg for at sende folk hjem for at bibeholde truppens kvalitet. Melissa Rycroft giver pigerne kostbare råd.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Living the Dream
programme.desc: Kelli kundgør endelig truppen. Skader truer starten af Cowboys træningslejr. Kaos på kampdagen kan indebære fejl, men deres optræden skal være fejlfri.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2
programme.desc: I den sidste runde er konkurrencen benhård. Nu skal dem, der er gået videre, dyste mod erfarne veteraner for en af de eftertragtede pladser i DCC's træningslejr.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3
programme.desc: Træningslejren begynder! De nye kandidater er spændte, og fulde af beundring, da de møder veteranerne for første gang på Valley Ranch.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4
programme.desc: Der er kun gået to uger af træningslejren, da det er tid til at begynde at sende folk hjem. Uniformsprøven er det første punkt på dagsordenen. Det er bittersødt for de nye, for de har endnu ikke gjort sig fortjent til dragten.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5
programme.desc: Efter at have taget afsked med en af deres egne, må træningslejrkandidaterne se sandheden i øjnene - ingen plads i truppen er sikker. Hårdføre Kitty Carter bliver bedt om at arbejde med de svage kandidater og få dem i form.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Hele gruppen trænger til at blive rusket og gæstekoreografen Kitty Carter står til tjeneste. Truppen må gennemlide en benhård dansetime og nogle af pigerne bryder totalt sammen. Så er det tid til en lektie i DCC's etikette.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: Nogle drømme går i opfyldelse, når de heldige træningslejr-kandidater står model i den ikoniske Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders-dragt under en sexet fotooptagelse.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: Flere skal sorteres fra, og der er kun to undervisningstimer tilbage, men pigerne kæmper for at få deres berømte cowboystøvler på for første gang. Så skal Judy og Megan Fox give kritik ved den sidste dans.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 1
programme.desc: 600 nervøse og spændte Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader-aspiranter ankommer til et hotel til de første udtagelser. Hver deltager får mindre end to minutter til at udføre en freestyle-danserutine foran dommerne.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2
programme.desc: I de sidste udtagelser er det kun de stærkeste, der overlever. DCC-aspiranterne skal nu konkurrere mod veteranerne om en plads i træningslejren.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3
programme.desc: Hvis kandidaterne troede, at udtagelserne var hårde, får de sig en overraskelse, når den brutale træningslejr går i gang. Uge 1 på Valley Ranch starter med, at pigerne finder ud af, hvad dommerne havde at sige om dem.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4
programme.desc: Det er kun den tredje uge af træningslejren, men det er allerede tid til at frasortere. Hvem vil overleve? Ugen starter med en dragtprøve, hvor aspiranterne får lov til at prøve den berømte blå, hvide og stjernebestrøede dragt.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5
programme.desc: Det er tid til at få pigernes DCC-look frem. Glat eller krøllet hår? Lyshåret eller rødhåret? Pigerne ved ingenting om, hvad Kelli og frisøren Rainer Schneck har planlagt for dem, når de får deres dramatiske DCC-makeover.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Da DCC-chefen Kelli Finglass giver en tidligere aspirant en unik chance for at springe til på træningslejren efter tre uger, har hun meget at indhente.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: Hun er tilbage! Den krævende Kitty Carter kommer til Valley Ranch for at undervise de nervøse DCC-dansere i danseteknik. Så tager Charlotte Jones Anderson de forundrede cheerleadere på en privat rundtur i det nye Cowboys Stadium.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: Kelli og Judy må tage svære beslutninger, som er retfærdige, men beklagelige. Det er opgørets time for de resterende træningslejrkandidater, da der kun er to dansetimer tilbage før den sidste eliminering.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 1
programme.desc: For første gang er det pragtfulde Cowboys Stadium i Texas basen for udtagelserne til Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders. Over 600 aspiranter med drømme om at komme med i truppen 2010-2011 ankommer før solopgang til indledningsrunden.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 2
programme.desc: De 47 nye piger, som skal deltage i DCC's finaleudtagelser, har haft to uger til at forberede sig, men er de klar til at danse sammen med de 27 tilbagevendende DCC-veteraner?

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 3
programme.desc: DCC's træningslejr begynder i aften! Kandidaterne ankommer til Valley Ranch for første gang og får muligheden for at møde deres idoler og mentorer - DCC-veteranerne.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 4
programme.desc: Den anden uge af træningslejren bliver nogle af aspiranterne sendt hjem. Nogle få udvalgte veteraner skal filme et segment til Good Morning America, og de hjælper med at realisere en livslang drøm for en heldig dame.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 5
programme.desc: Uge fire af træningslejren begynder med, at de nye får en DCC-makeover. Fra hår og sminke til selvbruner og tandblegning bliver aspiranterne forvandlet til DCC-repræsentanter.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 6
programme.desc: Træningslejren er snart slut, og DCC-portrætterne står på banen. Træningslejr-aspiranterne og veteranerne er klar til deres nærbilleder, klædt i specialsyede DCC-dragter med perfekt hår og makeup.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 7
programme.desc: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders-truppen 2010 bliver bekendtgjort i løbet af de næste to dage. Det siger sig selv, at det er en stressende tid for træningslejr-aspiranterne. Tiden er inde til at imponere.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Episode 8
programme.desc: 34 nyankomne og veteraner møder op i dragten for at tage gruppebilledet. Men der sættes en dæmper på glædes dag, fordi Dallas Cowboy Cheerleaders direktør og koreograf endnu ikke har offentliggjort truppen 2010.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Prøverne begynder
programme.desc: Cowboys Stadium i Arlington, Texas huser igen optagelsesprøverne til Dallas Cowboys' cheerleadere. 500 kandidater, der drømmer om at komme på DCC-holdet i 2011-12, ankommer før solopgang til de første prøver.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: På banen
programme.desc: Det flotte Cowboys Stadium er stedet for DCC's sidste prøver. Spændingen er stor for de 69 nye piger, da de 18 DCC-veteraner slutter sig til kampen om de eftertragtede invitationer til træningslejren.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Træningslejren
programme.desc: DCC's træningslejr begynder i aften på Valley Ranch! Presset på de nye kandidater er tydeligt, mens de prøver at planlægge og skaffe sig nye boliger i Dallas.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Den berømte uniform
programme.desc: Der er gået to uger af træningslejren, og Kelli og Judy begynder at vælge de første fra. Ugens øvetimer er vigtige for alle pigerne, da de forventes at mestre den verdensberømte DCC-kickline og at gå i spagat.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeovers
programme.desc: Det er træningslejrens tredje uge, og de nye hentes ind til deres DCC-makeovers. De får et nyt look med frisure og makeup og forvandles i DCC-støbeformen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: PR-fotos
programme.desc: Aftenens prøver starter med et brag, da DCC's Technical Director Kitty Carter aflægger et uventet besøg på Valley Ranch.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: På banen
programme.desc: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders er to uger fra den første kamp og DCC's leder Kelli McGonagill Finglass og DCC-koreografen Judy Trammel har travlt med at udskille de sidste og sætte holdet.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: På banen
programme.desc: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders er to uger fra den første kamp og DCC's leder Kelli McGonagill Finglass og DCC-koreografen Judy Trammel har travlt med at udskille de sidste og sætte holdet.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Finalen
programme.desc: Alt afhænger af træningslejrens sidste aften. I aften opfyldes eller knuses drømme. Kelli udfordrer pigerne ved at tage dem med på Cowboys' træningsbane for at se dem optræde.

programme.desc: I denne to timers sæsonpremiere på Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team. 600 kandidater ankommer til Cowboys Stadium til Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders indledende prøver.

programme.desc: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 1
programme.desc: Robson Green, the actor and host of Extreme Fishing TV series is our guest. He has never fished for Icelandic salmon. We travel to the remote pools of Kjarrá by helicopter and fish pools that are untouched the whole summer.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 2
programme.desc: Charles and Alex Jardine travel to the highlands of Iceland looking for monster arctic char. Charles Jardine is a respected artist who specializes in painting fish and fisherman. The river they fish is a gin clear river, home to some huge trout.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 3
programme.desc: Tiggy Pettifer, a passionate angler, is visiting Iceland. She is a well known personality in the UK being a former employee of the royal family. Tiggy gos to lake Thingvallavatn and looks for the Ice age brown trout that the lake is famous for.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 4
programme.desc: The 93 year old Lilla Rowcliffe is coming to Iceland for the 30th time. Fishing the same river. Big Laxá. She brings along her grandson and great grandson that is 11 years old. Lilla has had an astonishing live and shares a bit of that live with us.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 5
programme.desc: Mother and daughter fish both river Vídidalsá and river Midfjardará. The mother Joanna Gibson is taken along with her daughter Marina Gibson who is a highly skilled fisherman and runs her own very successful fly fishing school in Europe.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 6
programme.desc: Robson Green is back with a friend and a colleague. Actor James Murray joins him for an adventure in Iceland. Fishing Laxá in Asum, or just Asum the two give a great performance in this famous river. Competition is on.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Lake Otamangakau
programme.desc: Andrew Harding and Matt Hince team up to visit a huge man-made lake - one of New Zealand's most famous trophy trout waters - in the country's North Island: Lake Otamangakau.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Southland Smelters
programme.desc: New Zealand's Southland's four major rivers are famous as brown trout fisheries, especially in the upper and middle sections, but in this episode Anto Hall and Mike Wilkinson are heading to the estuaries, to fish the annual smelt run.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Golden Bay Kingfish
programme.desc: Discovering new waters to fish is among the pinnacles of the fly fishing experience, and this saltwater flats fishery, Golden Bay, is just such a gem. Kingfish have a unique relationship with short-tailed stingrays, which they use as mobile cover.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Backcountry Kaimanawas
programme.desc: This episode of Pure Fly NZ sees a helicopter ride take anglers Cory Scott and Chris Charland deep into the the mountains to target New Zealand's famous trophy trout, but will an approaching weather-bomb cause them a headache.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Tauranga Taupo
programme.desc: Lake Taupo was formed in the caldera caused by an enormous volcanic explosion. The Tauranga is one of the few tributaries that the lake's legendary rainbow trout use to spawn.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Autumn Chromers
programme.desc: The South Island's Otago Lakes District is the location for remarkable autumn trout fishing brought about by the fish leaving the lakes and heading upstream to spawn.

programme.sub-title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun

programme.title: I'm Not There

programme.title: The Last Redemption

programme.title: Big Top Pee-Wee
programme.desc: Pee-Wee Herman er en simpel bonde i en lille by. Men snart kommer en stor storm deres vej. Et cirkus ender på Pee Wees gård. Så han lader cirkusset blive på gården i lidt tid. Cirkusset beslutter at lave et show med en elskværdig stjerne, Pee-Wee!

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: 'Cold War' er en passioneret kærlighedshistorie om to mennesker med meget forskellig baggrund og vidt forskellige temperamenter. De er helt forkerte for hinanden, men er alligevel via skæbnen dømt til at forblive sammen.

programme.title: Banana Joe

programme.title: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert

programme.title: The Stepford Wives

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer more closely and with evermore fidelity at nearby stars, they are discovering countless exo planets. How many Earth-like planets are out there? Could one of them hold life not so different from our own?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.sub-title: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.sub-title: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.sub-title: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.sub-title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.sub-title: Moon Shots: Inside the lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System

programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.
